_comment: ONE required check (2026-07-27). secret-scan and dep-audit used to be separate jobs in security-gates.yml; they are now STEPS of typecheck-test — same detectors, same blocking behaviour. 2026-08-01: every job moved from the single self-hosted runner to fresh GitHub-hosted runners (repo is PUBLIC — free, 20-job concurrency). duplication-gate and E2E Smoke Test still run and still go red, but are deliberately NOT required: duplication-gate was de-required 2026-07-02 (flaky at token boundaries, blocked BET-57/PR#27, and agents cannot rerun CI), and Electron+Xvfb e2e is flakier than the deterministic gates. Both are judgment signals the PM and reviewer read. THIS FILE MUST STAY IN SYNC with the main branch ruleset's required contexts (Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> main) — they are two separate places, and requiring a context no job produces blocks every PR forever. Change the ruleset FIRST, then this file.
